review_candidates.title: Linux Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Partnering with teams across the organization, they will troubleshoot complex technical challenges, modernize operational processes, contribute to governance and platform strategy, and create shared knowledge that strengthens team capability. Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) Knowledge of major Linux operating systems (RedHat, SuSE, Ubuntu) Experience diagnosing and resolving Linux operating system and service-related issues, including performance bottlenecks, system reliability concerns, disk
eligibility_evidence: This role is not eligible for VISA sponsorship What You Will Do Support, deploy, manage, and work on projects supporting both small functional workloads as well as mission-critical enterprise systems.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) Knowledge of major Linux operating systems (RedHat, SuSE, Ubuntu) Experience diagnosing and resolving Linux operating system and service-related issues, including performance bottlenecks, system reliability concerns, disk utilization problems, and configuration errors in production environments. Experience with patch deployment tools and patch management automation (RH Satellite, Landscape, Automox, Uyuni) Experience managing cloud infrastructure in AWS Experience in a mission-critical production environment, understanding the importance of communication, risk management, responsible follow-through, post-incident analysis, and coverage participation Experience working directly with end users and the ability to meet them where they are at technically for communication What Will Put You Ahead Containers and related technologies, such as docker, podman, co
